name: ai-automation-results-v3
target: Участник сам внедрил ИИ или автоматизацию в бизнес-процесс и описал измеримый результат

ai_business.instructions: Does the author name concretely what they personally built or deployed, an AI tool or automation, that is already running and used for a business task? Answer no for plans, questions, discussion of tools made by other people, announcements, AI-generated text pasted as an answer, and general exclamations about having built something without saying what it does.

criteria.true: The message says what the finished automation or AI tool does (for example a function, a process or a business task) and that it is in use now.
criteria.false: Planned or unfinished work, questions, complaints, discussion of tools made by others, news, AI-generated text pasted as an answer, or a general exclamation such as having made an app or a robot without any concrete description.

measurable_result.instructions: Does the author report a measurable result: time saved, cost reduced, revenue, number of items processed, or a percentage improvement?

criteria.true: A specific number or clearly quantified benefit is stated.

category.instructions: Which area does the automation belong to?

criteria.documents: Documents, scans, contracts, PDF or Word files.
